title: We are trying to raise a €2.5 million Series A round to fund expansion into the German legal market but all three venture funds we spoke to in Q1 said our cap table structure is too messy from the 2019 convertible note round; we need legal restructuring advice, not technology.

record.text: We are trying to raise a €2.5 million Series A round to fund expansion into the German legal market but all three venture funds we spoke to in Q1 said our cap table structure is too messy from the 2019 convertible note round; we need legal restructuring advice, not technology.
record.detail: In 2019 we issued a convertible note to bridge a funding gap. The terms were set in a hurry and the resulting cap table now shows overlapping anti-dilution provisions that make it hard for a new lead investor to model their ownership cleanly. We have spoken with three regional venture funds this year, all of whom expressed interest in the product but pulled back after reviewing our shareholder agreement. Our target is a €2.5 million Series A to fund a German market entry, including translation of the platform and local business development hiring. We need a corporate lawyer with cross-border experience in Serbian and EU startup financing to help us clean up the note terms, renegotiate with the existing noteholders, and produce a cap table that a German or Austrian fund can read without confusion. This is not a technology problem. We have a moderate budget for legal advisory work and a soft deadline of Q3 this year if we want to start German operations before end of 2025.
